description: Current Bridge documentation establishes USDB issuer, 1:1 backing, reserve composition, segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness statements, conversion paths and supported chains, but this review does not establish authoritative current contract addresses for each supported chain, the precise legal form of the token-holder claim, or a universal direct-holder entitlement to reserve rewards independent of developer/platform distribution arrangements.
notes: Do not treat example API contract addresses as canonical deployment identifiers, and do not convert Bridge's developer marketing-fee economics into an intrinsic token-holder yield claim.
